decisions.reason: Deducting applicable fiat fees from the founder's share does not change the Transak provider, conversion flow, or supported payment methods.
The existing same-message MODIFY already states in anti_scam_copy that the founder's $4 share is reduced by fiat fees.
The founder-share fee treatment does not alter the fixed $5 no-referral commission or its random-holder allocation.
The founder-share fee treatment does not change which NFT state or entitlements transfer on resale.
The source leaves no-referral ticket triggers, recipients, and applicable draws unchanged.
The founder-share fee treatment has no effect on winner selection, ticket weighting, or Chainlink VRF verification.
The source continues to specify an immediate $5 referral commission and changes only how applicable fiat fees affect the founder's share.
The fee treatment does not change referral-code identity, permanence, display, sharing, or resale behavior.
The source does not change Big Block prize values, draw timing, ticket handling, or counted sales.
The founder-share fee treatment does not change any required NFT metadata attribute.
The source does not change Small Block prize values, draw timing, ticket handling, or counted sales.
The founder-share fee treatment does not affect email authentication or dashboard access for fiat users.
